component.name: 8BitDo SN30 Pro+ Bluetooth Gamepad
component.summary: Firmware for the 8BitDo SN30 Pro+ Bluetooth Gamepad

description.p: Update your 8BitDo SN30 Pro+ Bluetooth Gamepad to the latest firmware version to enjoy improved performance, new features, and bug fixes.
本次更新包含以下优化与修复：

ul.li: 调整启用 / 关闭配置组合键为 L3+R3+L1+R1（原组合键为 L3+R3）。
优化 Xinput 模式的摇杆死区范围。
优化 Switch 模式的振动效果。
修复 Switch 模式振动异常的问题。
修复连接 PS 接收器振动异常的问题。

description.p: This release includes the following improvements and fixes:

ul.li: The button combo to activate/deactivate the profile has changed to [L3+R3+L1+R1].
Optimized the dead zone range of the analog sticks in Xinput mode.
Optimized the vibration of the Switch mode.
Fixed the abnormal vibration issue in Switch mode.
Fixed the abnormal vibration issue when connecting to the PS Retro Receiver.

screenshot.caption: Hold the Start button for 3 seconds to power off the controller, then press L1 + R1 + Start to enter update mode. The power indicator will flash, and then reconnect the controller.
